basis: Generic reference composition for common foods and standard portions. Values are intended for tracking, not laboratory analysis.
source_note: FoodData Central is used as the structural/reference model for nutrient fields; this bundled library is curated and not a live USDA API mirror.
variation_note: Brand, recipe, cooking method, edible portion and drained weight can materially change nutrient values.
persistence: Each log stores a nutrient snapshot; later library changes do not erase historical nutrient values.
note: Generic curated reference servings; brand/recipe-specific values can differ. Leblebi is generic unsalted roasted chickpea.
